doc: SuperTrend with ADX. SuperTrend (period 10, multiplier 3): an average-true-range trailing stop that flips when the close crosses it, the indicator widely attributed to Olivier Seban (the 10, 3 default is TradingView's); the line under price is the long stop, over price the short stop. ADX with +DI and -DI (14) from J. Welles Wilder, New Concepts in Technical Trading Systems, Trend Research 1978: ADX above 25 means a trend worth following and +DI over -DI an up-trend; take SuperTrend flips only while ADX is above 25 and rising, and treat them as noise in a range (ADX below 20).
